URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reform_UK_donations_scandal
(Aggregated background; primary reporting via Reuters/US News and Courthouse News)
Also: https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2026-07-10/british-police-investigate-donations-to-farages-reform-party

British police are investigating at least £500,000 in donations to Nigel Farage's Reform UK made by the mother of a close political ally who was convicted of wire fraud.

- The inquiry centres on two donations of £250,000 each made by Fiona Cottrell to Reform in May 2024, weeks before the general election.
- Police are investigating potential offences under laws governing donations to political parties, which could include concealment of the source of funding or giving false information to the treasurer of a party.
- The investigation began in February 2025 after the Electoral Commission referred the matter.
- On 9 July 2026 the Met announced two individuals have been interviewed under caution. No arrests have been made.
- Separately, the Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards is investigating a £5m undeclared donation Farage received from Thailand-based cryptocurrency billionaire Christopher Harborne before announcing his candidacy in the 2024 general election.
- On 7 July 2026 Farage resigned as MP for Clacton and declared his intention to run in the resulting 2026 Clacton by-election.
